bear_case: The KOSPI session on June 29 is the definitive refutation of the Samsung Blue House bull case as a near-term market catalyst: Samsung itself fell 5.3% on the largest corporate investment announcement in Korean history. This is textbook 'buy the rumor, sell the news' — and the rumor had been building for five days across prior briefings. The US futures are green (+0.5%) on the US-Iran stand-down, but this is the fourth ceasefire-related market event in six weeks; each prior version was violated within days (Iran struck Bahrain and Kuwait with ballistic missiles Saturday, less than 24 hours before the stand-down agreement). BTC Day 7 exit gate is locked — seven consecutive UTC closes below $63,500, IBIT $1.79B weekly outflows — with no re-entry gate close. NVDA premarket at $195.15 is 15 cents from forced institutional exit; the KOSPI sell-the-news reduces the probability that today's US close holds the stop level. Quarter-end $165B selling (JPMorgan) begins today and is explicitly concentrated in mega-cap Growth — the exact names (NVDA, MSFT, AAPL, QQQ) where longs are most extended. PCE 4.1% YoY is the structural inflation constraint preventing regime normalization. The NFP July 2 binary into the July 3–6 holiday gap means any regime resolution from today's session has a 48-hour window before an unhedgeable binary event. Counter-argument to the bear case: Fear & Greed at 25 (Fear) and IBIT outflows at seven consecutive days represent contrarian extremes historically associated with tradeable bottoms. The Samsung $226B AI data center commitment is real regardless of Korean price action — Jensen Huang's supply chain is booked. Invalidation: SPX closes above 7,460 AND VIX closes below 17 simultaneously today; NVDA closes above $200; BTC posts two consecutive UTC closes above $62,000. All three simultaneously would convert STEP ASIDE to HOLD.
